title: 2022 scans finding hidden chambers in the Great Pyramid

tellings.quote: So in 2022, they actually did a Giza um the Great Pyramid of Giza scans and they found hidden chambers beneath the Great Pyramid,

plain: In 2022, scans of the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt found hidden chambers beneath it, according to a researcher named Jay Anderson. He says this on Jesse Michels's show in 2025, without naming who did the scans or where he read it, as a sign that the pyramid still holds secrets.
